name: @ncsound/station-client
description: Typed client for the NCSound station-web public API. Shared by the listener app and the web player, so mount names, response shapes and offline handling cannot drift.

comments.dependencies: None on purpose: this client is dependency-free at runtime. station-core is a type/test-only dependency (the schema key type and the contract test's injected validator).
comments.test: Deliberately `bun test`, not `node --test`: `bun run` puts a `node`->`bun` shim on PATH, so a `node --test ...` script executes as `bun --test ...`, which is not the test runner, and every node:test import dies with "Cannot use test outside of the test runner". That made `bun run test` at the repo root fail on this package.
